claude.rationale: The slice documents only that the acquired Sun business was folded into OceanFirst's single consolidated financials, with Sun-specific traces limited to declining tax-attribute footnotes (net operating losses, a static AMT credit) and retained Sun-originated trust-preferred vehicles remaining on the balance sheet. No product/process incoherence is documented (p4=0), and the slice expressly states no branch-count or operating-performance trajectory specific to the former Sun business is established, so no operations-vs-organization fracture is documented (p5=0). Whether branches were closed, retained, or renamed is marked [UNVERIFIED], and nothing indicates archetype incoherence or business-model incompatibility.

Likewise, no fracture at the process/organization interface (operations vs people/management/culture) is disclosed—OceanFirst reports the acquired business only inside a single consolidated entity with no Sun-specific operating or integration-failure narrative in the 2021–2023 window.
